topic: Nostalgic documentary-style story of how Cristiano Ronaldo went from the most hated player to Ballon d'Or winner (2003-2008), using archive press and match clips
hero_role: protagonist of the documentary narrative; Sir Alex Ferguson as the key interviewee
hook: Chapter title '2003-04 / 6 GOALS / BALLON D'OR: 12th' over Sporting-era Ronaldo clip
subtitle_style: Chapter card: large white bold italic year with smaller 'GOALS/BALLON DOR' lines; lower-centre white sans captions (burned-in transcript of interview) with small 'Nost FC' watermark
transition_summary: Hard cuts between archival interview talking heads and match clips; ~2-3 cuts per 10 s; chapter title cards
audio_note: Archive Ferguson press-conference audio and period commentary (transcript: 'Proclaimed by Sir Alex Ferguson as one of the most exciting young players...') probably with narration/music
